Welcome to Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel
Welcome to Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel Dublin. Our 18th century 4 star luxury castle hotel is located near the historic village of Dalkey and the coastal town of Dun Laoghaire & only minutes from Killiney Beach, nestled next to Killiney Hill, with panoramic views over Dublin Bay and beyond. The Family owned & run Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel, now in its third generation offers guests tranquility, breathtaking scenery and old world elegance which blends seamlessly with the hotels modern luxury making it the ideal location for business or pleasure .

History of the Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel in Dublin
History
The original house, Mount Mapas was built in 1740 by Col. John Mapas, although records show that a building or buildings stood here at a much earlier date. By 1755 it was acquired by a Captain Maunsell who was succeeded by a Colonel Loftus in 1770.
The Colonel's stay was a short one; in 1772 he advertised the castle and its 150 acres for sale despite his short tenure. During his time in residence however, Colonel Loftus and his nephew converted the barren stoney soil to meadow and pasture and cut a road around the hill, his successor was Lord Clonmel who in 1790 improved the estate further spending 3,000 in the process, a handsome sum of money in the early 19th century.
The name Robert Warren is very much associated with the Castle and it was he who in 1840 enlarged the house and called it Killiney Castle. He also restored and added to the monuments on the hill, repairing the obelisk originally erected by Col. Mapas and donated land and most of the money for the building of Killiney parish church. The land on the hill once part of the estate was purchased from his son, Robert Warren Jnr. by Queen Victoria's jubilee memorial association and subsequently renamed Victoria Hill as we still know it today.
Its subsequent owners included a Mrs Chippendale Higgan. The trees and shrubs she planted can still be seen today and provide a decorative setting for the castle.
In the 20th Century Killiney Castle was used by the Black & Tans, the IRA and the Republicans in the civil war before being burnt by Free State Troops. It was requisitioned by the Government during the 1939-45 period and used as billets for the army
In the 1970s, the late Paddy and Eithne Fitzpatrick transformed Killiney Castle into a first-class hotel, renaming it Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel. Paddy's daughter Eithne Fitzpatrick Scott-Lennon continued to lead the hotel with her family since 2002, preserving its original charm and warm Irish welcome. Now in its 53rd year of operation under the Fitzpatrick name, the hotel has undergone significant changes and upgrades to its offerings since it first opened its doors. The hotel has now embarked on a new era, the third generation of the family, Managing Director Mark Scott-Lennon and Hotel Manager Joseph Scott-Lennon, have taken the helm as co-directors and continue to uphold the values of hospitality and excellence that have defined this establishment for generations to come.

Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel Dublin FAQs
Frequently Asked Questions
FAQs
....some of what you need to know.
Does the Aircoach stop at the hotel?
No, the aircoach does not stop directly at Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel. The nearest stop is located on Hyde Road in Dalkey, which is a short distance from the hotel.
How do I get from the airport to the hotel?
The air coach is available from Dublin airport and stops at Dalkey Village. It is a 50/60 minute drive from the airport to the hotel via the M50.
What time is check-in?
Check-in is any time after 3 pm.
What time is check out?
Check-out is at 12.00 pm midday.
Can I request a late checkout?
Yes, late check-outs are done by request.
What forms of payment are accepted?
A valid credit or debit card is required to check in to the hotel, but guests may use cash or credit/debit card at check-out to settle their bill.
Does your hotel offer parking?
Yes, we have onsite parking which is free of charge.
Does the hotel offer Wi-Fi?
Yes, there is complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.
What time is breakfast served at?
Breakfast is served in PJ's restaurant from 7.00 am-10.00 am Monday-Friday, and 7.30 am-10.30 am at weekends.
What are the dining options?
PJ's restaurant is open for breakfast every morning from Monday - Friday breakfast is served from 7 am-10 am Saturday & Sunday breakfast is served from 7.30 am-10.30 am. Mapas restaurant is open from 5.30pm-9.30pm Monday-Saturday, and 5.00pm-9.00pm on Sunday. Our Dungeon bar is open from 5.30 pm until 11pm Monday-Sunday.
Do you cater for food allergies?
Yes, we do cater for food allergies. If you have any special dietary requirements, please notify a member of staff.
Is your hotel pet friendly?
Guide dogs and assistant animals only.
Do you have a hairdryer in the rooms?
Yes.
Do you offer tea/coffee facilities?
Yes, tea/coffee is available daily in our Library Bar/Main Lobby area from 8.00 am.
Do you provide irons and ironing boards?
Irons and ironing boards are available on request.
Do you allow smoking?
Smoking is not permitted in any part of the hotel or in the guestrooms.
Do you have a leisure centre?
Yes, we have a fully equipped gym with a free weight area, a 20m indoor swimming pool, a Jacuzzi, sauna room, an aerobic studio offering a variety of classes.
What facilities do you offer families?
We have a selection of family rooms, catering for 2 adults and up to 3 children. We have a 20m indoor pool offering family swims throughout the day and there is a playground next to the hotel at Killiney Hill.
What leisure activities are available near the hotel?
You can walk or climb Killiney Hill to enjoy the stunning views of Dublin Bay, with a playground for the children. Dalkey castle and heritage centre offers local culture and history. Experience the excitement of horse racing at Leopardstown, and shopping at Dundrum town centre. If you have your golf clubs with you, there are a variety of golf courses within 10 miles of the hotel. Dublin city centre is just 20 minutes on the Dart from the hotel, offering a variety of tourist attractions including the Guinness storehouse and Dublin Zoo.
Do you have interconnecting rooms?
Yes, there are interconnecting rooms available at an additional cost.
Do you have wheelchair-accessible rooms?
Yes, and please feel free to contact us about any special needs you may have.
Is there a safe in the rooms?
Yes, a safe is provided free of charge in our guestrooms and suites.
What is your cancellation policy?
All reservations have a 24 hour prior to the arrival cancellation policy. On certain reservations, a special cancellation policy may apply. If booked through a third party, please contact the booking agent directly for cancellation policies.
How do I book groups into the hotel?
Please contact our reservations team on 01-2305559 or email reservations@fitzpatrickcastle.com
Do you accept Go Anywhere Gift Cards?
Yes, Go Anywhere Gift Cards can be redeemed at Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel. For more information, please see our Go Anywhere Gift Card section.

Castle Hotel Rooms & Accommodation
Rooms at Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel
The bedrooms at Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel offer a combination of luxury and comfort.
Just a short walk from Killiney Beach, 20 minutes drive from Dublin City, and overlooking Dublin Bay, we're the ideal base for your next stay in Dublin.
All 113 en-suite boutique bedrooms are individually designed to ensure a relaxing stay, we want to ensure you are impeccably looked after during your stay with us so luxury duvets, power showers, and fluffy towels are standard in all rooms. Each room is designed for your maximum comfort with soft white luxury linens, bespoke furniture, and beautiful hand-picked accessories, and rich fabrics with walk-in showers and free high-speed Wi-Fi.
TYPES OF ROOMS
From our Seaview rooms overlooking views of Dublin Bay to our Classic Rooms for your everyday needs to our spacious Family Rooms ideal for families to our opulent original 18th century Castle Suites, Fitzpatrick Castle Hotel caters for your every need, allowing you to simply relax and unwind.
AMENITIES
Full use of our leisure center with a whirlpool spa, Scandinavian wood sauna, steam room, 20 m heated swimming pool and the gym is included when you book any of our room types. Guests now also have the opportunity to book our Snooker room for their leisure and enjoyment.
